root_cause.text: `mt76_connac2_mac_write_txwi_80211()` dereferenced `mgmt->u.action.u.addba_req` in the mt76/mac80211 management-frame path without first verifying that the skb contained enough bytes for an ADDBA request, allowing an out-of-bounds read on short action frames.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds `skb->len >= IEEE80211_MIN_ACTION_SIZE + 1 + 1 + 2` immediately before checking `mgmt->u.action.category == WLAN_CATEGORY_BACK` and `mgmt->u.action.u.addba_req.action_code == WLAN_ACTION_ADDBA_REQ`, and the commit message explicitly says this is to “Check frame length before accessing the mgmt fields ... to avoid a possible oob access,” with the added fix covering `mgmt->u.action.u.addba_req.capab`.

intent_record.intent_summary: Add a length check before parsing action frames to prevent out-of-bounds access on short ADDBA request packets.
intent_record.what: An additional شرط was inserted into the existing `if` statement in `mt76_connac2_mac_write_txwi_80211()`: `skb->len >= IEEE80211_MIN_ACTION_SIZE + 1 + 1 + 2`. The rest of the condition and body remain unchanged.
intent_record.how: At runtime, the ADDBA request handling path now only executes when the skb is long enough to safely contain the expected action frame fields. This prevents the code from reading beyond the packet data when inspecting `mgmt->u.action.u.addba_req`, avoiding invalid memory access on short or malformed frames.

relevance_review.reason: The change adds a length check before parsing action frames, which directly addresses the out-of-bounds read caused by dereferencing ADDBA request fields on short management frames.

candidates.rationale: This condition dereferences the ADDBA request union fields on any action frame before verifying the frame length, so short action skbs can trigger an out-of-bounds read.
This statement directly reads the ADDBA request payload from the skb without a preceding length check, which is the immediate out-of-bounds access described by the root cause.
This is part of the action-frame parsing path that leads to dereferencing the ADDBA request structure, and it occurs before any validation of whether enough bytes are present.

bic_trace_step.reason: The vulnerable logic is present in this function body. In `mt76_connac2_mac_write_txwi_80211()`, the code unconditionally dereferences management-frame ADDBA fields after only checking the frame type/category: `if (ieee80211_is_action(fc) && mgmt->u.action.category == WLAN_CATEGORY_BACK && mgmt->u.action.u.addba_req.action_code == WLAN_ACTION_ADDBA_REQ) { ... }`.
